15-SEO / search engine optimization

Goes here. Technical and content optimization strategies for Generative Engine Optimization (GEO). Adapting a Shopify store to ensure AI search engines (like ChatGPT or Perplexity) can discover, match, and recommend products. Includes managing crawlability, schema markups, explicit keyword matching for AI processing, and building external brand reputation.

Not here.

• Visual layout and conversion rate optimization for landing pages -> 07-LPG

• General app installation tutorials or backend operational setups -> 05-SET / 21-OPS

Header.

url:

rights: public_reference

why: Introduces the "Found, Matched, Chosen" framework for adapting Shopify SEO to the emerging landscape of AI search engines, emphasizing technical readability and explicit data structuring.

modules: [SEO]

topics: [GEO, generative engine optimization, AI search, technical SEO, structured data, keyword matching]

tier: 3

scope_hint: growth

Topics. AI discoverability / the "Found" stage, ensuring the robots.txt file does not block AI agents (e.g., testing with curl -A ClaudeBot), avoiding JavaScript-dependent content rendering that hides text from crawlers, implementing proper schema markup for structured product data; the Shopify Global Product Catalog / enabling the Agentyc storefront requirement to allow inclusion in backend AI product catalogs (bypassing open-web scraping); AI keyword matching / the "Matched" stage, replacing fluffy marketing copy with hard, specific data facts (e.g., container size, exact colors, exact use cases) so AI can filter the product into the top 100 candidates; AI recommendation logic / the "Chosen" stage, recognizing that final AI recommendations rely on off-page reputation and social proof (external reviews on platforms like Reddit), similar to traditional backlink authority.

Look for.

The JavaScript Readability Check: The recommendation to disable JavaScript in the browser and reload the page to see exactly what an AI crawler sees, ensuring that critical content (like reviews or FAQs) isn't hidden behind delayed app widgets.

The Global Catalog Check: The specific tip to use Shopify's "Sidekick" AI assistant to verify if a store's products are eligible for the Shopify global product catalog, which feeds independent AI shopping tools.

Explicit Fact Matching: The shift in product description copywriting from vague, fluffy marketing language (e.g., "perfect for life on the go") to explicit, factual keywords (e.g., "insulated water bottle, green, cold drinks") because AI relies on exact data points to build shortlists.

Skip. Promotional pitches for the developer bootcamp or ideas for how developers can charge clients for audits.

Scope mix. 100% growth (advanced strategies for AI search adaptation).

Volume. ~250 words.
